title.zh: 【Cross River 将 RLUSD 接入核心银行系统，支持通过 XRP Ledger 交易】
title.en: 【Cross River 将 RLUSD 接入核心银行系统，支持通过 XRP Ledger 交易】

current_state.zh: Cross River Bank partnered with Ripple to embed the RLUSD stablecoin into its core banking system, letting fintech clients use a single API to move funds between USD and RLUSD over the XRP Ledger for 24/7 cross-border payments, initially in select states.
current_state.en: Cross River Bank partnered with Ripple to embed the RLUSD stablecoin into its core banking system, letting fintech clients use a single API to move funds between USD and RLUSD over the XRP Ledger for 24/7 cross-border payments, initially in select states.
